manifest.title_fil: Tumugon sa kagat at tusok ng insekto
objectives_fil: Ihiwalay ang lokal at agarang senyales, humingi ng tulong sa hirap sa paghinga at ilahad ang saklaw ng gamot.
objectives_en: Sort local versus urgent signs, activate help for breathing difficulty and state medication boundaries.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Pantal sa buong katawan at hirap sa paghinga matapos ang tusok.
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Widespread hives and breathing difficulty after a bee sting.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kilalanin ang posibleng malubhang allergy, humingi ng emergency help at bantayan ang paghinga.
sections.takeaway_en: Recognize a possible severe allergic reaction, call emergency help and watch breathing.

sections.takeaway_fil: Humingi agad ng emergency help sa posibleng malubhang allergy.
sections.takeaway_en: Call emergency help immediately for a possible severe allergy.

check.prompt_fil: Matapos ang tusok, may pantal sa buong katawan ang adult at hirap siyang huminga. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: After the sting, the adult has widespread hives and says breathing is difficult. What do you do first?

options.fil: Subukan muna ang home remedy sa tusok at tingnan kung gagaling.
options.en: Try a home remedy on the sting first and see if it settles.

options.fil: Humingi agad ng emergency help sa posibleng malubhang allergy.
options.en: Call emergency help now for a possible severe allergy.

options.fil: Ituring na karaniwang tusok at pakalmahin lang ang tao.
options.en: Treat it as a routine local sting and reassure the person.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag maantala sa home remedy kapag hirap sa paghinga. 2: Tama. Maaaring malubhang allergy ang pantal na may hirap sa paghinga; humingi agad ng emergency help. 3: Hindi karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not delay referral for home remedies when breathing is difficult. 2: Correct. Hives with breathing difficulty may be a severe allergic reaction; activate emergency help immediately. 3: Breathing difficulty is not a routine local sting. Call emergency help now.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tumatawag muna si Lea; ang gamot ay ayon sa plan ng tao at lokal na protocol.
sections.takeaway_en: Lea calls first; medicine follows the person's plan and local protocol.

sections.takeaway_fil: Walang pagkaantala sa home remedy; walang gamot nang walang training at pahintulot.
sections.takeaway_en: No home-remedy delay; no drug outside training and authorization.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang gamot ay ayon sa reseta at protocol, hindi sa hula.
sections.takeaway_en: Medicine follows the prescribed plan and protocol, not a guess.

check.prompt_fil: Habang naghihintay, nag-alok ang kaibigan ng tablet mula sa kanyang bag. Ano ang sasabihin mo?
check.prompt_en: While you wait, a friend offers the person a tablet from a bag. What do you say?

options.fil: Ibigay na; mas mabuti ang anumang allergy tablet kaysa maghintay.
options.en: Give it now; any allergy tablet is better than waiting.

options.fil: Ako na ang pipili ng mas matapang na gamot sa kit.
options.en: Let me choose a stronger one from the kit instead.

options.fil: Ang gamot ay ayon sa sariling reseta at protocol niya.
options.en: Medicine follows the person's own plan and protocol.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag magbigay ng gamot nang walang training at pahintulot. Bantayan ang paghinga habang paparating ang tulong. 2: Hindi pahintulot ang pagkakaroon ng gamot sa kit. Manatili sa training at protocol. 3: Tama. Sundin ang iniresetang emergency plan ng tao at ang sanay/lokal na protocol, at bantayan ang paghinga.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not give a drug outside training and authorization. Keep watching breathing while help comes. 2: Having a medicine in the kit is not authorization to give it. Stay within training and protocol. 3: Correct. Follow the person's prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol, and keep watching breathing.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
